description:
Use this when the user names a trading card or sealed product and you need its
    TickerMint product_id (required by card_price and price_history) or its set id
    (group_id, required by set_prices). Returns up to 25 matches with name, set,
    collector number, the latest raw market price in USD and the page URL. Covers
    Pokemon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound, Yu-Gi-Oh and Gundam only.

game.description: Limit to one game (pokemon, one-piece, lorcana, riftbound, yugioh, gundam). Omit to search every game.
game.title: Game

query.description: Card or product name, optionally with set or collector number, e.g. 'charizard ex 199/165'.
query.title: Query

name: search_cards
title: Search cards
